build.productionDiff:
diff --git a/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/NativeMokuCapsule.swift b/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/NativeMokuCapsule.swift
index ab9ec56..6f4721f 100644
--- a/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/NativeMokuCapsule.swift
+++ b/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/NativeMokuCapsule.swift
@@ -134,23 +134,24 @@ struct NativeMokuCapsuleGlass: View {
                 .glassEffect(regular ? .regular : interactive ? Glass.clear.interactive() : .clear,
                              in: .rect(cornerRadius: NativeMokuCapsuleLayout.cornerRadius))
                 .overlay {
-                    if !regular {
-                        shape.fill(LinearGradient(stops: [
+                    // Keep these layers mounted through Note's morph. Inserting
+                    // them on close starts at the final small size while glass
+                    // still contracts, painting a detached pill above the eyes.
+                    shape.fill(LinearGradient(stops: [
                             .init(color: Color.black.opacity(0.99 * strength), location: 0),
                             .init(color: Color(red: 0.04, green: 0.035, blue: 0.03).opacity(0.96 * strength), location: 0.40),
                             .init(color: Color(red: 0.16, green: 0.13, blue: 0.10).opacity(0.70 * strength), location: 0.72),
                             .init(color: Color(red: 0.38, green: 0.33, blue: 0.26).opacity(0.12 * strength), location: 1),
                         ], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom))
-                    }
+                        .opacity(regular ? 0 : 1)
                 }
                 .overlay {
-                    if !regular {
-                        shape.strokeBorder(LinearGradient(stops: [
+                    shape.strokeBorder(LinearGradient(stops: [
                             .init(color: .white.opacity(0.04 * strength), location: 0),
                             .init(color: .white.opacity(0.08 * strength), location: 0.55),
                             .init(color: Color(red: 1, green: 0.92, blue: 0.78).opacity(0.65 * strength), location: 1),
                         ], startPoint: .top, endPoint: .bottom), lineWidth: 0.8)
-                    }
+                        .opacity(regular ? 0 : 1)
                 }
         }
     }
diff --git a/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/README.md b/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/README.md
index b92402c..26e3910 100644
--- a/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/README.md
+++ b/app/macos/Sources/Host/MokuScene/README.md
@@ -265,10 +265,19 @@ it does not clear the catalog note or change the composer draft.
 
 Note's Regular material is noninteractive; text selection, links, scrolling,
 history and dismissal retain their existing native targets. Returning to the
-collapsed Dock restores its clear interactive material. Reduce Transparency
+collapsed Dock restores its clear interactive material. The warm gradient and
+fine edge remain mounted at zero opacity while Note is open, then fade back
+on the same resizing shell. Inserting them only at dismissal would give them
+the final small layout while glass is still contracting, visibly separating
+the black pill from the eyes. The persistent layers follow opening, closing
+and interrupted reversals without a second shell or delayed completion.
+Reduce Motion removes the inherited geometry/opacity animation; Reduce Transparency
 uses the same opaque warm-black fill in both states. The targeted
 [performance investigation](../../../../../tools/verification/moku-note-performance/README.md)
 records measured layout savings and the limits of its offscreen evidence.
+The [Note transition preview](../../../../../demos/moku-note-transition/README.md)
+records the production Dock with synthetic notes, including intermediate frames,
+rapid reversals, narrow/centered layouts and a local no-animation fixture.
 
 ## Voice display
